ev.q: In each jurisdiction, full vaccination coverage among persons experiencing homelessness was substantially lower (11.2–37.2 percentage points)
Full COVID-19 vaccination coverage among persons experiencing homelessness ranged from 18.6% to 44.5% in the six jurisdictions
Coverage with at least 1 COVID-19 vaccine dose across the six jurisdictions ranged from 22.0% to 52.0%
compared with 43.6% to 59.8% in the general population
in a convenience sample of six jurisdictions

methods_quotes.q: The percentage point differences in vaccination coverage between persons experiencing homelessness and the general population were calculated, along with 95% CIs.
were obtained by performing data linkage between immunization information systems and homeless services data systems
Numbers of vaccinated persons experiencing homelessness were identified by performing record matching between immunization information systems and homeless service access data
